caption: The drawing depicts a single dress, rendered in detail. The dress features short sleeves and a fitted bodice with a V-shaped neckline. Its fabric is light-colored, predominantly beige or off-white, and covered with a repeating small blue and red geometric pattern throughout most of the dress. The bodice and overskirt have additional detailing: the peplum-style overskirt is trimmed with multicolored decorative borders consisting of floral patterns in red, blue, yellow, and green, as well as narrow blue fringe. The skirt is long and wide, extending to the floor, and is divided into several panels; some vertical panels display an intricate floral motif with larger flowers in pink, red, yellow, and green, spaced between cream-colored sections of smaller motifs. There are no visible human figures or other objects in the drawing, and the background is plain and unadorned. The image is drawn and colored in a way that highlights the details of the garment and its printed fabric.
title: Girl's Dress
